lines.text: The man brought Ezekiel back to the gate facing east, and the earth shone with the glory of the God of Israel.
Ezekiel fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east.
The Spirit brought Ezekiel into the inner court, and the LORD said He would dwell among the Israelites for a season.
The LORD told Ezekiel to describe the temple so Israel would be ashamed, and all the territory on the mountain would be most holy.
The statutes for the altar said to give a young bull as a sin offering to the Levitical priests of the family of Aaron.
